link_destination.sql:
WITH arch AS (
  SELECT org, pod_record_id, substr(value, 7, 1) AS rtype
  FROM records
  WHERE field_tag = 'LDR' AND length(value) >= 8
    AND (substr(value, 7, 1) IN ('t','d','f','p')
         OR substr(value, 8, 1) IN ('c','d'))
)
, links AS (
  SELECT a.org, r.pod_record_id,
         regexp_extract(lower(r.value), 'https?://([^/]+)', 1) AS host
  FROM arch a JOIN records r USING (org, pod_record_id)
  WHERE r.field_tag = '856' AND r.subfield_code = 'u' AND r.value LIKE 'http%'
)
SELECT org,
  CASE
    WHEN regexp_matches(host, 'findingaid|archives') THEN 'finding_aid'
    WHEN host IN ('oac.cdlib.org','www.oac.cdlib.org')
         OR regexp_matches(host, 'archivegrid|snaccooperative') THEN 'aggregator'
    WHEN regexp_matches(host, '^(nrs|arks|purl|hdl|handle)\.')
         OR regexp_matches(host, 'doi\.org$') THEN 'resolver'
    WHEN regexp_matches(host, 'proquest|amdigital|gale|jstor|e-enlightenment')
         THEN 'vendor'
    WHEN regexp_matches(host, 'colenda|digital|repository|dspace|fedora|idn\.duke')
         THEN 'repository'
    ELSE 'other'
  END AS category,
  count(DISTINCT pod_record_id) AS n
FROM links GROUP BY org, category

sql.label: Archival records by 655 genre/form term
sql.sql:
WITH arch AS (
  SELECT org, pod_record_id, substr(value, 7, 1) AS rtype
  FROM records
  WHERE field_tag = 'LDR' AND length(value) >= 8
    AND (substr(value, 7, 1) IN ('t','d','f','p')
         OR substr(value, 8, 1) IN ('c','d'))
)
SELECT a.org, lower(rtrim(trim(r.value), ' .')) AS category,
       count(DISTINCT r.pod_record_id) AS n
FROM arch a JOIN records r USING (org, pod_record_id)
WHERE r.field_tag = '655' AND r.subfield_code = 'a' AND trim(r.value) <> ''
GROUP BY a.org, category

sql.label: Archival records by decade of first date (008)
sql.sql:
WITH arch AS (
  SELECT org, pod_record_id, substr(value, 7, 1) AS rtype
  FROM records
  WHERE field_tag = 'LDR' AND length(value) >= 8
    AND (substr(value, 7, 1) IN ('t','d','f','p')
         OR substr(value, 8, 1) IN ('c','d'))
)
SELECT a.org, (CAST(substr(r.value, 8, 4) AS INTEGER) // 10) * 10 AS decade,
       count(*) AS n
FROM arch a JOIN records r USING (org, pod_record_id)
WHERE r.field_tag = '008' AND length(r.value) >= 11
  AND regexp_matches(substr(r.value, 8, 4), '^[0-9]{4}$')
  AND CAST(substr(r.value, 8, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 100 AND 2025
GROUP BY a.org, decade ORDER BY a.org, decade

sql.label: Archival records with an 856 online link
sql.sql:
WITH arch AS (
  SELECT org, pod_record_id, substr(value, 7, 1) AS rtype
  FROM records
  WHERE field_tag = 'LDR' AND length(value) >= 8
    AND (substr(value, 7, 1) IN ('t','d','f','p')
         OR substr(value, 8, 1) IN ('c','d'))
)
SELECT org, count(*) AS n FROM arch
WHERE (org, pod_record_id) IN
      (SELECT org, pod_record_id FROM records
       WHERE field_tag = '856' AND subfield_code = 'u')
GROUP BY org
